Hey Product Hunt 👋   
  
I'm Tyler, co-founder and CEO of Overmind.

Overmind is the open-source platform for AI agent training. What we're working towards is giving every product its own AI lab. 🚀

Most AI products run on the same few frontier models. A frontier lab works differently, collecting data, building evals, training, testing. Ship and repeat.

> We wanted any team building an agent to be able to run that same loop on its own data, without hiring an ML team or building infrastructure.

To get started: Connect our MCP, and paste one prompt into Cursor, Claude Code, Codex or OpenCode.

What you get: [...] Maker

Heyyy PH, Frey here, founding engineer at Overmind.

When most teams hear "build your own AI", they picture a research lab, a GPU budget and a year of hiring. We think it should feel more like flipping a switch. So we built one open-source platform that watches every agent you have in production, learns from your own data, trains models made for those agents and keeps making them better well after launch. All of it runs on your own infrastructure, so your data never leaves your hands. The traffic you see today turns into tomorrow's training set, and your agent gets a little better every day.
